name: Afghan Refugee Relief
mission: Afghan Refugee Relief (ARR) is a proud, 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization focused on resettling refugees, asylum-seekers and humanitarian parolees in Southern California.
theoryOfChange: Afghan Refugee Relief states in their 'Our 2022 Impact Report' that their purpose is to 'develop the optimal framework to successfully integrate Afghan refugees in the United States.' They aim to 'leverage the successful implementation of our framework to inspire greater strides in policy and progression for refugees of all backgrounds.' The report details their mission to help Afghan refugees resettle, assimilate, and thrive in America, and outlines programs such as Financial Aid, Project Sabr, Women Empowerment, and Tutoring. This indicates a structured approach to achieving and measuring their impact.

strengths_deep_dive: Afghan Refugee Relief focuses heavily on immediate physical and financial relief for arriving families. According to operational reports, the group <cite id="2">furnished 200 homes, distributed 750 laptops, and provided 1,700 phones</cite> alongside <cite id="2">$85,000 in direct financial aid</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Afghan Refugee Relief partners with local nonprofits and volunteers to assist refugee families arriving in the United States <cite id="2">through direct resettlement services</cite>. Their primary offerings include financial aid, distributing laptops, furnishing homes, and running community programs <cite id="2">such as Project Sabr</cite>. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="5">a total revenue of $205,225</cite> to support these operations. The organization achieves a low cost per beneficiary of $5.34 for its direct service delivery. However, financial filings from FY2024 show a program expense ratio of 28.9%, which falls well below the 75% sector benchmark and reflects significant spending directed outside core program execution. Donors can contribute through various online methods <cite id="3">to support community resettlement efforts</cite>.
